items.text: Settings now has a search box: type a word such as "passkey" or "webhook" and open the exact setting, including settings that live on a tool's own page, such as recordings. The Settings menu is sorted by who a setting belongs to: Brand, Workspace or You.

People, Companies and Deals now have one toolbar row: search, Filters, your saved view and Save view, then the count, table or board, sort, Columns and export. Show (Active, Held for review, Archived), Marketing email and Company moved inside Filters, and the Filters button counts them when they are set.
